commands.help: List scheduled tasks, flag user-owned (SID-suffixed) ones
commands.long_help: schtasks /query /fo csv /v captured in-process (no cmd.exe). Default: one detail block per user-owned task (name contains a machine SID suffix -S-1-5-21-...); those are owned by the current account and can be modified/run by it. -full 1: compact one-line table of all tasks, candidates marked '>>>'. No elevation needed.

arguments.name: full
arguments.desc: 1 = one-line table of all tasks; 0 = detail blocks of candidates
